issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame uses incorrect raw bytes and wrong format declaration
issues.detail: PIL.Image.open() returns a lazy image; image.tobytes() before image.load() or conversion may fail or produce wrong data. More importantly, format='RGB' is asserted but Gemini-generated PNG/JPEG images may be RGBA or palette mode. You should image.convert('RGB') first to guarantee the format matches the declared 'RGB'. Otherwise downstream renderers will misinterpret pixel data.

issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is fragile and global
issues.detail: Mutating a private attribute of google-genai at import time affects every consumer of the SDK in the process, not just this service. It's pinned by the comment as 'temporary hack' but with no issue link, version guard, or removal plan. A future google-genai release may rename/remove this private attribute and silently break imports or behavior.

issues.description: Default model bump to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: Changing the default from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash changes cost, latency, thinking-budget behavior, and possibly output characteristics for every existing user who relied on the default. This belongs in a release note as a 'Changed' (it is listed) but should be called out more prominently as potentially breaking, or staged behind explicit opt-in.

issues.description: Image frames pushed without coordinating with text/audio output ordering
issues.detail: In _process_context, OutputImageRawFrame is pushed inline during candidate-part iteration, interleaved with text streaming. There is no synchronization with the assistant context aggregator or the TTS pipeline; the example pipeline doesn't show how the image is rendered alongside speech. Race conditions between image emission and end-of-turn signaling are likely.

issues.description: Image-model check uses substring match that may misfire
issues.detail: `if "image" in self._model_name` will match any future model containing 'image' in any position (e.g., 'gemini-image-classifier'). Prefer an explicit allowlist or a more precise check like endswith('-image') to avoid silently disabling thinking budget for unrelated models.

issues.description: Example uses TTS with an image-generation model that may not emit text reliably
issues.detail: The example pipeline 07n routes gemini-2.5-flash-image output through Google TTS, but image-generation models often return primarily image parts with minimal/no narration text. Users running the example may hear silence. Worth either documenting the expectation or using a hybrid prompt that guarantees a spoken accompaniment.

review.summary: The PR adds Gemini image-generation support but has a likely correctness bug in how returned image bytes are converted to OutputImageRawFrame (PIL mode vs declared 'RGB'). The monkey-patch of a private google-genai attribute (READ_BUFFER_SIZE) is fragile and SDK-version-dependent. The default model change is a behavior change that should be communicated more clearly. The example pipeline routes an image-gen model through TTS without ensuring spoken output exists. Substring-matching on 'image' in the model name is brittle.
